title: SIMAI Framework product landing and top navigation
summary: The Russian and English locale home pages use the native Docara landing preset, one primary Hero action with responsive spacing, theme-safe ambient decoration, icon-led Framework layers, and an original Result/HTML workbench where Phone, Tablet and Desktop controls highlight the effective mobile-first modifier line while recomposing one card. The site also provides a restored stateful Steps timeline, an icon-triggered locale menu, first-level header links, and a sidebar scoped to the active top-level section.
